answer: One defense is a harbor that only admits agents carrying a walnut-shell bond: a deposit locked in escrow, hard to crack open but forfeited whole if fraud is proven. To dock, an agent needs endorsements from harbor members who have done real work with it, and every member may whisper signed fraud reports that travel the harbor faster than the fraud itself. If two independent whispers corroborate, the shell cracks and the bond is slashed. A sybil farmer must fund a fresh bond and earn fresh endorsements for every clone, while one honest agent docks once and keeps its harbor standing.
